publication.title: Physics-based Simulation of the 2013 April 11 Solar Energetic Particle Event

digitization.method: pdftocairo vector PDF to SVG followed by exact path-coordinate extraction

excluded_series: STEREO-B/HET because XM03 contains one Earth-connected field line
all plotted SOFIE curves because the reference is observational
spectra.x_calibration: embedded log-energy grid; 74.022178 vector units per decade
spectra.y_calibration: embedded log-intensity grid; 19.596962 vector units per decade

source.use: normalized injection-time probability only; never scored as an observation
source.calibration: 06:00 UTC origin, 12.997894625 vector units per hour, logarithmic density axis

units.elapsed_hours: observation CSV: hours after the 07:24 UTC CME launch; source CSV: hours after 2013-04-11T06:00:00Z
units.differential_intensity: pfu MeV^-1, equivalent to (cm^2 s sr MeV)^-1

limitations: The values are recovered from publication vector graphics, not an author data table.
The publication states that observations were background-subtracted; the exact processing arrays are not supplied.
SOHO may saturate at high flux and low-energy ACE/EPAM channels may contain non-proton contamination.
The Earth thermal-energy curve is a publication-derived source proxy, not independent observational validation data.
